description: This file is a PHP script for handling email campaign scheduling within the SuiteCRM application. It manages different modes of scheduling emails, displays appropriate views, and interacts with campaign and email marketing beans, including processing lists of email marketing instances based on campaign and prospect list data.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for managing list view rendering, including initialization, query setting, and rendering the list with provided data.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: A class used for template rendering and variable assignment for the user interface.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: Factory class for retrieving and creating bean instances such as Campaigns and EmailMarketing.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes a new template for list view rendering with specified template file and language strings

methods.name: setDisplayHeaderAndFooter
methods.description: Sets whether to display headers and footers in the list view.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the title displayed at the top of the list view.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Defines the SQL WHERE clause, sorting, and other query parameters for retrieving list data.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes and renders the list view given the data set, view identifier, and context.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns variables to templates for rendering.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the template with assigned variables.
